scenarios.name: Checkout address validation (e-commerce)
notes: Pipeline and AddressResult can validate and normalize a checkout address.
Suggest and reverse endpoints support search-as-you-type and map selection.
Missing a ready-made cookbook and sample flows targeted at checkout.

scenarios.name: Customer address book (account profile)
notes: Read-side behavior is usable for editing and confirming addresses.
Persistence and listing belong to another domain.
Needs a short integration guide for account profile flows.

scenarios.name: Bulk address validation (CSV import)
notes: Batch endpoint and pipeline can validate many addresses.
Quotas and metrics cover throughput.
No reference script or guidance for CSV yet.

scenarios.name: Store locator and pickup points (reverse geocoding)
notes: Reverse geocoding endpoint can power a store locator.
Integration with map widgets and caching patterns is not documented.

scenarios.name: Multi-tenant SaaS (tenant quotas and metrics)
notes: Tenant quotas, guards and metrics are implemented.
Recent R23 metrics decorator adds visibility into decisions.
Needs an operator-oriented configuration guide.

scenarios.name: Internal QA and regression testing
notes: Golden fixtures, fixture runner and SLO load runner are present.
Would benefit from a single QA checklist and more varied fixtures.

scenarios.name: Observability and dashboards
notes: Metrics and SLO concepts exist.
Dashboards and alert definitions are not yet shipped as artifacts.

scenarios.name: Discovery loop for product and integration teams
notes: Discovery tools exist (HTTP demos, fixtures, Docker quickstart).
Lacks a single narrative walkthrough for non-engineers.

scenarios.name: Compliance, audit and error analysis
notes: Metrics help but no dedicated audit trail or correlation guide.
No explicit documentation on data retention and privacy yet.

scenarios.name: Productized address quality score
notes: Validation issues are a good internal base.
No outward-facing scoring concept or UI yet.
Core pipeline, suggest, reverse and quota logic are implemented.
Several important scenarios can be built from existing pieces.
Targeted guides for concrete verticals are still missing.
Metrics and SLO tools exist but dashboards and alerts are not shipped.
Golden fixtures exist but the data set is intentionally small.
There is a demo tenant concept, but no cohesive demo story yet.
Technical entry points are good; narrative is still thin.
